svg.title: A shaded letter beside its number grid
svg.desc: On the left, a twelve by twelve shaded drawing of the letter T. On the right, the same twelve by twelve grid with a brightness number written in every square. Three squares are highlighted in both grids and joined by arrows.
svg.text: A shaded letter beside its number grid
Same square, same place, in both grids: 128, then 0, then 64.
12 x 12 = 144 squares, so 144 numbers. Nothing is left over.
